source.note: Hand sizes and the GM’s modifiers from ch.7 “Draw Challenge cards”; actions from ch.7 “Challenge Actions”.

player.note: Players always draw four; facedown cards in play do not reduce the draw.

gm.note: Recheck every round — as enemies fall, the GM draws fewer.

modifiers.label: Twice as many enemies as adventurers
Each enemy larger than a human

mulligan.label: Mulligan
mulligan.note: Discard the hand and draw again when it is mostly greater dooms. The book sets no threshold; the GM judges.

free.name: Talk in character
free.summary: No card needed. Talk in character on anybody's turn, unless something is restraining you.

free.name: Move within your zone
free.summary: No card needed. Move around inside your zone on anybody's turn, unless something is restraining you.

swords.name: Attack
swords.summary: Beat their Initiative to deal 1 Wound; a tie is yours unless they have a shield. Reveal their Initiative either way. A melee hit leaves you both engaged.

swords.name: Riposte
swords.summary: Play it facedown. When you are next Attacked or Roughhoused, reveal it after their action: beat its value to deal them 1 Wound. A tie is yours unless they have a shield.

pentacles.name: Avoid
pentacles.summary: Beat a guard's Initiative to get past it into an adjacent zone. To disengage, match or beat each engaged foe's Initiative; any you fall short of may deal you 1 Wound, and you move either way.

pentacles.name: Dash
pentacles.summary: Leave your zone and move two zones away.

pentacles.name: Dodge
pentacles.summary: Play it facedown. When you are next Attacked or Roughhoused, add its value to your Initiative; if that beats their action's value, it misses.

pentacles.name: Roughhouse
pentacles.summary: Beat their Initiative to Disarm, Displace, Root or Trip them. They need a Recover action to get rid of it.

cups.name: Aid Another
cups.summary: Play it facedown and name another adventurer's action as the trigger. When they take it, reveal it and add your value to theirs — the way past an Initiative above 14.

cups.name: Command
cups.summary: Order an animal companion to perform a command it knows. Against a foe, compare your value with their Initiative; otherwise any value will do. Companions act only when Commanded.

cups.name: Pull Item from Pack
cups.summary: Swap an item from your backpack with one you are holding.

cups.name: Use Item
cups.summary: Use an item you are holding. On yourself any value will do; against a foe, compare with their Initiative. A thrown bomb is an Attack in almost every respect, but on Cups.

wands.name: Banter
wands.summary: Taunt, intimidate or frighten. Beat the enemy's Morale (the GM judges it) and the GM shifts their Disposition one step — perhaps towards fleeing or surrender.

wands.name: Speak Incantation
wands.summary: Cast a spell whose talent you have, holding its component in one hand. Beat their Initiative and it takes effect; a tie is yours unless they have a shield.

wands.name: Recover
wands.summary: Get rid of one Effect you are suffering: stand up, retrieve a dropped weapon, wipe your eyes. The GM says which Effects can't be shaken off this way.

anySuit.name: Bid Lore
anySuit.summary: Any card. Try to recall an esoteric detail; the GM accepts, rejects or asks you to rephrase, and the card is spent either way.

anySuit.name: Guard
anySuit.summary: Any card, if you have a shield: replace your Initiative with a card from your hand, and discard the old one.

anySuit.name: Move
anySuit.summary: Any card. Move to an adjacent zone. If you are engaged, each foe engaged with you may deal you 1 Wound or let you pass; Avoid is the safe way out.

anySuit.name: Pull Item from Belt
anySuit.summary: Any card. Swap an item from your belt with one you are holding.

anySuit.name: Reload Crossbow
anySuit.summary: Any card. A crossbow must be reloaded after every shot.

anySuit.name: Test Fate
anySuit.summary: Any card, when the GM calls for a test of fate mid-fight. The card you play doesn't count: draw from the minor arcana deck and resolve it as a normal test of fate.

anySuit.name: Trivial Action
anySuit.summary: Any card. Anything quick and uncontested: open a door, throw a lever, pick something up, drop prone.

anySuit.name: Vigilance
anySuit.summary: Play it facedown, in the suit of the action you will take, and name another character's action as the trigger. When it happens, flip it and act. A greater doom can't pay for it.

gmOnly.name: Greater doom ability
gmOnly.summary: GM: a greater doom (15–21) pays for a creature's greater doom ability. Against an adventurer, play it with a lesser doom Attack; it lands if the Attack hits, and is spent either way.

gmOnly.name: Discard for favour
gmOnly.summary: GM: discard a greater doom to gain favour (+3) on another Challenge Action.

endOfRound.text: Everyone has had a turn. Take a quick look at the fight: if the guild has clearly won, the enemies surrender; if the guild is in a bad way, ask whether they want to retreat.
